newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state sells 80 pct in agriculture firm.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state sells 80 pct in agriculture firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state has privatised 80 percent of its stake in Nubareya Agricultural Engineering and Mechanisation for 21.43 million pounds ($6.31 million), the Capital Market Authority (CMA) report said on Tuesday.
The report showed that a total of 793,750 shares were sold for about 27 pounds a share.
The Holding Company for Agricultural Development originally offered to sell 20 percent of the firm at a minimum price of 24.50 pounds per share. The offer opened on May 18.
Corporate sources told Reuters that applicants would get about five to six percent only of what they asked for.
The sale is part of Egypt's privatisation-led economic reform programme.
